versions.changelog: v1.0.5 - brand promo link updated to https://www.xiaoyaosai.com/ (docs-only change: SKILL.md bilingual promo line; no behavior change).
Docs only: replaced the XiaoyaoClaw promo line in SKILL.md with a bilingual XiaoyaoAI promo block (Chinese + English, project.xiaoyaosai.com). No functional, script, or metadata changes.

Second-round review fixes. The audit script now validates destinations at connect time (every resolved address checked when the socket is created, closing the DNS-rebinding gap) and only uses ports 80/443. Package hygiene: repo-side process notes and scan evidence are excluded from the published bundle, and IP literals were replaced with plain-language descriptions so documentation describing blocked ranges is not misread as accessing them. Permissions: Env dropped from allowed-tools, with an explicit per-tool purpose list and a hard scope for Bash (runs only the bundled read-only audit script). Docs: README install instructions no longer copy agent instruction files into the repo root and state that nothing is written into your project automatically; inLanguage is a neutral placeholder; llms.txt examples are restated as a site property with an explicit audience scope.

Security review fixes (25 findings). Audit script: destination validation (public hosts only; loopback, private, link-local, cloud-metadata, CGNAT, reserved and IPv6 ULA ranges refused) re-checked on every redirect hop with a 3-hop cap; streamed response-size caps (1 MB HTML / 256 KB text); ANSI/OSC and control-character stripping for all remote-derived output (terminal-injection guard); max 10 domains per run. Docs and policy: dropped comments from assets/readme/hero.svg (hidden-instruction finding); declared allowed-tools plus network/permission boundary; explicit non-persistence statement (no cron, daemons, startup scripts or cross-session state); narrower activation (a named site/URL plus an explicit SEO action, with negative examples); production change-safety rules for robots.txt, sitemaps, redirects, canonicals, hreflang, noindex, DNS and routing config; language-optional note across the docs, configurable inLanguage placeholder, bilingual hero subtitle.
Add GitHub doc and XiaoyaoClaw promo links to SKILL.md header

Initial release: comprehensive SEO auditing and optimization skill for websites.

- Supports full-site (audit), page-level, content quality, schema, and AI search optimization workflows.
- Diagnoses technical SEO, traffic drops, ranking issues, AI search visibility, and structured data.
- Provides actionable, prioritized fixes, with clear verification steps for each recommendation.
- Multilingual workflow and triggers (English/Chinese); ready for Google, Baidu, Bing, and emerging AI search engines.
- Strong security: analyzes only page data, never executes embedded instructions.
